about_the_game:
Battle Brewers is a chaotic potion crafting game, where you and up to 3 friends are tasked to defend a castle by brewing up potions with various effects. Potions can affect your units, enemies or spawn new units. 

50+ Ingredients!

Brew potions to banish your foes, support your own units or create a field full of special tiles applying various effects. The possibilities are nearly endless! Brew potions with 50+ different ingredients, each having 3 different effects that you can apply to your potion, with the only limitation being your creativity in how you use them!

Explore a different world

Dive into this magical world where you and your friends are tasked with saving different castles from a variety of monsters and enemies. Explore 10+ different level themes, all with their own mechanics and unique units for you to fight or spawn.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500U
  • Memory: 750 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • VR Support: VR is not supported

short_description: Battle Brewers is a 1-4 player couch party game where you are in charge of brewing potions to defend a castle in multiple chaotic levels. Brew potions that apply buffs, deal damage or spawn units, all to prevent the castle from falling to the incoming waves of different enemies!
